name: Gilbert von Obsidian
original_name: ギルベルト=フォン=オブシディアン
source:
The first prince of the military superpower Obsidian. He's a refreshing young man who seems harmless at first glance, but inside he's a pig king. The symbol of evil that everyone is wary and afraid of has a hidden secret that will kill you the moment you find out...?

"Hello, gentlemen of the Rhodolite Kingdom. Are you still energetic and awkwardly struggling?"

[Translated from in-game bio]
